Eli: quick ping — new user reports the NextJS+LlamaIndex starter sometimes shows duplicated assistant messages after a network hiccup. seen on both local and Vercel preview.
Carmen: ah that sounds like the retry + streaming merge bug we discussed. which SDK version?
Eli: using redwood-js v0.7.0-canary and the sample's LangChain adapter. repro steps in gist: https://gist.github.com/eli/next-dup-stream.
Vik: can you paste the adapter wrapper? suspect we're re-sending the same delta chunks when a retry happens.
Eli: core snippet:
Eli: ```js
// langchain-adapter.js
async function handleStream(stream) {
  for await (const chunk of stream) {
    // we buffer and emit to socket
    buffer.push(chunk);
    socket.emit('delta', chunk);
  }
}
// on retry we re-call handleStream with the previously-open stream
```
Tara: yep that pattern is dangerous. if the SDK retry replays the stream it should include idempotency tokens or allow the app to detect resumed ranges.
Carmen: SDK currently retries at the transport layer and reconstructs a new ReadableStream. streaming semantics aren't preserved across retries. we probably need two things: 1) streaming-safe retry policy (no replay by default), 2) a client-side reconnection protocol that resumes with cursor.
Vik: for immediate fix: turn off automatic retries for streaming endpoints in the starter. Add guidance in README: use streamingRetries: false and handle intermittent reconnects.
Eli: quick patch applied locally and it removed duplicates in my repro. diff: 
Eli: ```diff
- const client = new RedwoodClient({ retry: { attempts: 3 } })
+ const client = new RedwoodClient({ retry: { attempts: 3, streamingRetries: false } })
```
DevEx Bot: Note: ticket #6910 created by Eli: "next-starter: streaming duplicates on retry". CI will run sample smoke tests.
Tara: long-term: we should implement resume tokens in the protocol. I'll open a design doc and link it to #6910. Idea: server emits {cursor: n} every X tokens, client can request resume(n).
Carmen: also audit other starters for the same pattern — several templates buffer whole stream then re-emit on reconnect. low-friction fix: add a small util in the starter repo: safeStreamEmitter(stream, socket) that dedups using transaction ids.
Vik: on eval harness: the e2e_streaming.py test currently asserts exact transcript which makes flakiness explode when retries occur. change it to assert presence of semantic markers and token count bounds.
Eli: I'll update the starter README with the streamingRetries note and add a short code example for reconnect handling. PR #4922 drafted.
Carmen: assigning @Vik to tweak eval harness. ETA: 48h. also add a flaky tag to the current test so CI doesn't block merges.
Vik: got it. will add semantic assert harness + reuse staging preview to reduce full deploys.
Eli: thanks team — once PR merges I'll smoke the Vercel preview and report back here. :pray:
Tara: thanks Eli. linking this thread into the SDK parity board so Python/Go SDKs can adopt same streamingRetries flag.
DevEx Bot: PR #4922 opened (samples/next-starter: disable streaming retries, add README note). CI queued.
Eli: verifying now, preview looks clean. closing loop after CI green.
